units.source_text: 请看看吧，如今，对我来说，行动只不过是一种剩余的物资。

en.t: Please look: now, for me, action is nothing more than a kind of surplus material.

units.source_text: 这是从人生中挤出来的，是从我的意志中溢出来的，

en.t: It has been squeezed out of life, and has overflowed from my will,

units.source_text: 就像另一种冰凉的铁制机械似地放在我的面前，等待着启动。

en.t: like another cold machine made of iron, set before me and waiting to be started.

units.source_text: 这种行动和我，简直毫无关系。

en.t: This kind of action has absolutely nothing to do with me.
Up to this point, I am still myself.

units.source_text: 从此以后，我就不是我了……

en.t: From this point on, I will no longer be myself...

units.source_text: 我为什么一定要把自己变成非我呢？

en.t: Why must I turn myself into something that is not me?
